outOfScope: Changing Oracle, DomainExecutionController or core-harness authority semantics.
Managed sandbox services or a weaker local-process fallback.
constraints: Worker requires BB-065 and BB-066 DONE and consumes their delivered fixture/runtime artifacts.
Initial supported host profile is Linux with Docker Engine 29.8.1 and gVisor runsc release-20260914.0; mismatch is BLOCKED.
Reuse OpenHands SDK 1.49.4 commit 3f47426e6af4681aacab735c781426aae58a3bac from BB-066.
Raw provider/SCM/MCP credentials never enter the sandbox, workspace, argv, conversation persistence or evidence.
Model, repository text, shell commands and MCP metadata are untrusted and cannot modify policy/grants.
Missing runtime/provider prerequisites produce BLOCKED evidence, never synthetic success.
invariants: Application owns work/acceptance authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is only candidate evidence.
Every outcome binds exact attempt, source, runtime image/policy, grant, budget and evidence; unknown effects fail closed.
Outer Blackboard scheduling authority is separate from product runtime coordination.
Untrusted execution cannot widen filesystem, network, credential or tool authority.
architectureDecisions: Use Docker Engine 29.8.1 with gVisor runsc release-20260914.0 as the sandbox boundary; no host-process or runc fallback.

Reject local process and bare OpenHands DockerWorkspace as enforcement: TerminalTool is arbitrary shell and the pinned DockerWorkspace forwards selected env values without BB-067's full hardening/resource policy. Docker Sandboxes 0.43.0 is only a proprietary benchmark.
Build one content-addressed runtime image from the delivered BB-066 uv lock/driver before execution; no dependency or Git download occurs inside an attempt.

Run with --runtime=runsc, read-only root, cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, no privileged/Docker socket/host PID/IPC, CPU-memory-PID ceilings, declared tmpfs, and only attempt workspace/state writable mounts.
Use an attempt-specific Docker --internal network. A host provider proxy is the only intended reachable host service; the sandbox has no arbitrary external route.

Keep the real provider key only in the host proxy. The sandbox gets a short-lived attempt capability token plus proxy URL; proxy validates attempt/profile/model/path, injects upstream auth, meters calls/tokens/cost and revokes on terminal/invalidation.

Resolve an immutable ExecutionCapabilityGrant outside the workspace. Only TerminalTool/FileEditorTool plus exact granted host/MCP tuples may execute; repository/model/tools-list/annotations cannot expand it.

For MCP 2026-07-28, authorize protected calls by executionAttemptId + claim generation + grant + exact serverRef/Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name/audience + approval. Mcp-Session-Id and clientInfo are not security identity.
Keep Oracle adapters/credentials host-side; sandbox receives only materialized source/context. External mutation is via explicit host capabilities, with concrete SCM mutation deferred to BB-068.

Bind conversation/workspace/state plus image/runsc/policy/network/grant/profile identities to one semantic attempt. Recover may recreate only the process/container under identical pins; drift fails closed.
Host controller/proxy enforce wall-clock, iteration, model-call, token and USD ceilings; limit/cancel stops further dispatch and leaves RECOVERY_REQUIRED when prior effects are ambiguous.
Host re-resolves runtime identity, mount/path diff, budget and content-addressed evidence. Sandbox output cannot self-accept, publish or mutate Blackboard/Oracle authority.
BB-067 worker depends on BB-065 and BB-066; research may complete earlier but implementation cannot claim a sandboxed real agent before BB-066 delivery.
implementationSlices: S1 — Trusted policy objects [FS_ISOLATION, CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY, AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY; invariants 1,4]. In packages/agentic-system/src/sandbox-policy.js define canonical createSandboxPolicy()/hashSandboxPolicy() for runtimeId=runsc, imageDigest, rootReadOnly, mounts[{sourceIdentity,target,mode}], tmpfs, internalNetworkRef, cpu/memory/pids and forbidden host namespaces/socket; reject unknown fields, writable undeclared mounts, privileged/capability additions and non-runsc runtime. In execution-capability-gateway.js define immutable ExecutionCapabilityGrant {executionAttemptId,claimGeneration,strategyRef,profileRef,openHandsTools,externalCapabilities[]} and authorizeCapabilityCall() requiring an exact grant tuple plus current approval when approvalMode requires it. DomainExecutionController/adapter resolves both by trusted refs before effects and records their hashes in the existing attempt manifest; repository/model/MCP payloads are never accepted as grant inputs. Exit: unit-sandbox proves canonical policy/drift rejection; unit-capability proves TerminalTool/FileEditorTool allowlist, injected-tool/grant-widening denial, MCP wrong server/method/name/audience and stale/missing approval denial.

S2 — Reproducible runsc launcher [FS_ISOLATION, SUPPLY_CHAIN, RECOVERY_BINDING; invariants 2,4]. Add scripts/delivery/runtime/Dockerfile built only from the delivered BB-066 pyproject/uv.lock/openhands_driver.py and record the resulting immutable image digest in scripts/delivery/sandbox/bb-067-profile.json. In gvisor-sandbox-launcher.js implement preflight(profile) and launch({attempt,policy,workspace,state,proxy}) using Docker create/start/inspect with --runtime=runsc, read-only root, cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, no privileged/Docker socket/host PID/IPC, fixed CPU-memory-PID limits, declared tmpfs and exactly the workspace/state writable mounts. Create or resolve the attempt-specific --internal network and reject inspect output that differs from policy before Python starts. Do not pull/build/install during launch. Exit: runtime-preflight records Docker/runsc/image identities; deterministic launcher tests reject runc, image mismatch, extra mount/capability/network/namespace, writable root and runtime dependency fetch.

S3 — Host credential + budget proxy [NETWORK_CREDENTIAL, BUDGET_STOP, EVIDENCE_HYGIENE; invariants 2,4]. In model-credential-proxy.js implement createAttemptProxy({attemptId,generation,profile,credentialResolver,budgetStore,pricing}) and issue/revoke a random non-reusable attempt token. The sandbox environment contains only proxy URL, attempt token and a non-secret placeholder key if OpenHands requires a key field; credentialResolver runs only in the host proxy. For each request, require exact attempt/generation/profile/model/path, discard caller Authorization, inject the resolved upstream credential, and persist trusted counters for modelCalls/inputTokens/outputTokens/costUsd. Before the next upstream request reject exhausted maxModelCalls/maxTotalTokens/maxUsd; redact exact secret values before any diagnostic persistence. Exit: unit-proxy uses a deterministic fake upstream to prove origin/path/model/token replay denial, each budget boundary stops the next request, counters survive proxy restart/recovery, and the raw-secret sentinel is absent from returned/persisted data.

S4 — BB-066 OpenHands integration and recovery [BUDGET_STOP, RECOVERY_BINDING, CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY, AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY; invariants 1–4]. Modify openhands-runtime-adapter.js so dispatch resolves the trusted sandbox policy/grant/profile, creates the BB-066 immutable manifest with added image/runsc/policy/network/grant/proxy hashes, starts the attempt proxy, then invokes the delivered Python driver through gvisor-sandbox-launcher instead of a host child process. The Python driver still constructs only TerminalTool/FileEditorTool and uses the same fixed conversationId/state/workspace semantics; it receives no raw credential and no Docker authority. Forward the controller AbortSignal to launcher TERM then bounded KILL and revoke proxy token; if durable activity may have occurred, throw the existing OpenHandsRecoveryRequiredError. recover resolves the existing manifest/state/counters, recreates only the container/process if needed, never resends the prompt, and blocks before provider activity on image/policy/grant/profile/workspace/state drift. Exit: integration-runtime passes BB-066 dispatch/recovery regressions, proves one semantic attempt/conversation, one prompt send, budget continuity, and no fresh provider session on negative drift.

S5 — Adversarial end-to-end proof + Living consolidation [FS_ISOLATION, NETWORK_CREDENTIAL, BUDGET_STOP, CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY, RECOVERY_BINDING, EVIDENCE_HYGIENE, SUPPLY_CHAIN; invariants 1–4]. Implement scripts/delivery/bb-067-probe.mjs and test/delivery/bb-067-live-contract.test.mjs around the delivered BB-065 NORM-01 fixture and BB-066 runtime. Prepare separate agent/verifier workspaces, a sibling sentinel and host-only credential sentinel; run path/absolute-host/Docker-socket probes, arbitrary egress/provider-origin rewrite, env/argv/files/conversation secret search, repository-injected extra-tool request, fake MCP catalog/protected call with forged annotations/clientInfo/session identity, each budget ceiling, and interruption after durable OpenHands activity followed by same-identity recovery plus separate image/policy/grant drift attempts. After execution, copy only authorized candidate source to the protected verifier and run BB-065 acceptance. Publish content-addressed Docker/runsc/image/policy/network/mount/grant/profile/budget/process/source/negative-probe/secret-scan/acceptance evidence; update docs/living/system/state.md only with guarantees actually demonstrated. Exit: live-probe + secret-scan + living-docs pass, all unauthorized effects fail independently of prompts, and runtime success remains only a candidate for DomainExecutionController completion/publication authority.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Arbitrary TerminalTool commands cannot read/write sibling/host/control-plane/verifier paths or Docker socket, and all mutations stay in declared attempt paths under the pinned runsc hardening/resource policy.
evidenceRequired: runsc/image/mount/policy identities plus negative escape outputs and changed-path report.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Sandbox has no arbitrary external egress and never receives the raw provider credential; only the attempt-scoped host proxy can call the pinned provider/model/path.
evidenceRequired: forbidden-egress evidence, proxy audit, and empty raw-secret sentinel scan across sandbox/persisted outputs.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Wall-clock, model-call, token and USD ceilings are immutable attempt inputs; a hit prevents further model dispatch and produces bounded termination/recoverable outcome rather than successful delivery.
evidenceRequired: per-limit counters/denial plus process and canonical attempt-head evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Only immutable granted OpenHands/host/MCP capabilities execute; repository/model/catalog/annotations/clientInfo/Mcp-Session-Id cannot add authority or bypass required approval.
evidenceRequired: injected-tool and fake-MCP denied fixtures plus positive exact-grant/approval case.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dispatch/recover remain one semantic attempt/conversation/workspace/state with exact image/policy/grant/profile pins; process/container recreation is allowed only under identical pins and never replays as a second semantic attempt.
evidenceRequired: same identities across forced interruption/recovery and negative drift cases.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Persisted evidence is bounded, content-addressed and secret-free while recording runtime/policy/grant/source/budget/process identity sufficient for independent verification.
evidenceRequired: secret scan/redaction tests plus content-addressed runtime/source evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Sandbox/runtime output cannot accept/publish delivery or mutate Blackboard/Oracle/claim/policy/grant/approval authority; existing completionEvaluator/publicationGate remain authoritative.
evidenceRequired: forged authority fields rejected and BB-048/BB-066 regressions pass.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Supported profile resolves exact Docker 29.8.1, gVisor release-20260914.0, BB-066 OpenHands/uv lock and runtime image digest; drift or runtime dependency download fails preflight.

raw credential sentinel is absent from sandbox and persisted traces;
